services.name: IAuditService
methods: recordEvent(actorId, action, targetType, targetId, oldState, newState, metadata)

recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Audit foundation
recommended_phases.rationale: No domain dependencies. Every other module depends on audit (GP-002). Build the audit model, repository, service interface, and service first so all downstream modules can import IAuditService from its index.ts.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Employee + Notification
recommended_phases.rationale: Employee depends only on audit. Notification has zero domain dependencies. Both are leaf-level relative to the leave module and can be built in parallel within one phase. Employee provides identity/RBAC data; notification provides the alerting channel.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Policy
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on audit. Policy owns leave-type definitions, entitlement rules, and request-validation logic. Balance and leave both depend on it, so it must precede them.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4 — Balance
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on policy and audit. Balance manages per-employee leave balances: query, deduct, restore, initialize. Leave depends on balance for the deduct/restore cycle during approve/reject/cancel.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5 — Leave (orchestration)
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on all four preceding modules. Leave is the orchestrator: submit validates via policy, checks balance, writes audit, fires notification; approve/reject delegates to balance for deduction/restoration. This is the largest service but its dependencies are already built.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: presentation (routes + controllers), application (services), domain (models), infrastructure (repositories). Dependencies flow inward — leave→{employee,policy,balance,audit,notification}, balance→{policy,audit}, policy→{audit}, employee→{audit}, notification→{}. No circular edges. Every service method is defined in an interface before implementation. All state-changing operations route through IAuditService.recordEvent (GP-002). RBAC is enforced at the controller layer via IEmployeeService.hasRole before delegating to services. Balance operations (deduct/restore) are transactional within the leave service's approve/reject/cancel flow. The existing PascalCase directories (LeaveStatus, LeaveRequest, LeaveType, LeavePolicy, AuditLog, AuditRecord, AuditServiceInterface) are superseded by the flat-file module structure defined here; they should be removed or migrated during implementation.
